text:
**Ra.One** centers on a new technology in London that allows digital elements to enter the real world through wireless transmissions. The game features a protagonist, G.One, whose face is given to the programmer Shekhar Subramaniam. The antagonist, **Ra.One** , is a faceless entity imbibed with a self-learning AI and possesses greater powers, including shapeshifting and mind reading.
When the game is launched, the self-aware Ra.One breaks free and enters the real world, leading to the murder of Shekhar Subramaniam after he attempts to save his son, Prateek. Prateek and Jenny then attempt to bring G.One to life, and after G.One enters the real world, he fights Ra.One. G.One eventually defeats Ra.One by shooting him without his H.A.R.T. attachment, and G.One transports himself back into the digital world. Months later, Prateek restores G.One to reality.
